errors.evidence: There is no green line in either chart. This line is entirely hallucinated.
The description does not state that the figure consists of two line plots showing the relationship between the IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote for Gesamtstaat and Zentralstaat.
The description omits the right y-axis (Schuldenquote) for both charts, including its label, units, and value ranges (60-120 for Gesamtstaat and 30-70 for Zentralstaat).
The description does not mention the correct IWF Fiskalindex range for the left y-axis (0 to 2.5 for the left chart and -5 to 2 for the right chart).
The description omits the right chart entirely, which shows the IWF Fiskalindex in relation to Schuldenquote Zentralstaat.
The description does not mention the use of triangle markers for data points in both charts.
